utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Can you hear me all right? Teams has picked the wrong microphone again.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, you're there. Honestly, the traffic on the ring road this morning. I spent longer looking at the same van than driving.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Lovely way to start a Friday. Bit of quality time with a diesel Transit.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And whose new car's in the car park? Very shiny. Brave, parking it next to that puddle.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one where the dirt is structural.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, Friday the 23rd of January. Let's do the closed stuff first, then what's actually ours to do.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah so, I finished the repair on the main conveyor last night. That's done, not something I'm carrying into today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good. Repair closed, then. There is a separate contractor booking on the list, but we're not reopening your repair.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the palletiser yesterday. That old entry can stop haunting the conversation.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Those entries live longer than the filters, usually.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: While we're clearing those, I signed off the inspection on the Injection Moulding Line 2 on Tuesday. All finished.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, those are completed items, not fresh jobs.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Only an observation from me: noticed the turbine two was running a bit warm on nights, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Settled back down, yeah? You're not raising another job there?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: No, just passing on what I saw. Nothing new for today off that.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Same sort of thing, separately — noticed the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit was running a bit warm on nights, but it settled down. Observation only.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Understood. Neither of those is going on as a new action.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the GT2. That's still blocked, before anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, there's no confirmed delivery date. Nothing firmer than what we had.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, existing blocker. Not inventing a new delivery job out of it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Davey, can you swap the filter on the dryer? Normal priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah. Routine filter swap, not suddenly the top of the pile?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Fine, I'll swap the filter on the dryer. That's mine.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fiona, can you investigate the pressure drop on the Water Booster Pump by the end of the week? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Um, yes — investigation, though, rather than me committing to having a repair finished?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yes, investigate the pressure drop. That's the action.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Okay, I'll investigate the pressure drop on the Water Booster Pump by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I know it's Friday already. Still matters, but don't treat that as a drop-everything one.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. That's clear.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Aisha, can you do a site visit at Kestrel with the contractor today, whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do the site visit at Kestrel with the contractor today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No particular slot from me. Whenever you get a chance, just within today.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: That's fine. Gives me a bit of breathing room.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Han, can you book a contractor to look at the main conveyor on the 3rd? Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, on the 3rd is when I make the booking, rather than you saying the contractor has to attend then?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yes, the booking action on the 3rd. Low priority; I'm not setting an attendance date here.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Right, I'll book a contractor to look at the main conveyor on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And that's separate from the repair I finished last night, just so those don't get mashed into one line.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly. Finished repair stays finished. This is just that contractor booking.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I've got the bearing one. I'll take vibration readings on the GT2 Number 2 Bearing by 11am. I'll drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Thanks, Priya Raman. Yes, drop everything for that one — by 11am is the important bit.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep. I'm taking it, readings by 11am.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, was talking over you there. Heard it now — that's the urgent one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fiona, the other one for you: can you run a function test on the air dryer by Wednesday? Fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: By Wednesday, yep. I've got that as a function test, not the filter swap.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Correct. Fairly important, but it's not in the same category as those vibration readings.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Okay, I'll run a function test on the air dryer by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Jamie, can you run the monthly fire alarm test today at 2pm? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, I'll run the monthly fire alarm test today at 2pm. Normal priority, fixed time — got it.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Two this afternoon, not part of this morning's noise, then.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Correct. My microphone is the only alarm you're getting from me this morning.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fiona, can you write up the near miss at the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock this afternoon? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I can't take that as well, sorry. With the Water Booster Pump investigation, I haven't got room for the write-up this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fair enough. Hannah, can you take that instead — write up the near miss at the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it instead of Fiona. I'll write up the near miss at the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Thanks. Just to be clear, that's off me, not both of us down for it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yes, Hannah owns that now. It matters but it's not urgent; this afternoon is still the deadline.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Understood. Mine, this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: One still needing an owner: do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve first thing tomorrow. That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I can't take that one. Don't put my name against the sign-off.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I can't commit to first thing tomorrow either. Sorry.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Anyone else able to take that exact sign-off? First thing tomorrow, safety critical — not something to drift.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Not me, I'm afraid. I can't accept it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Nor me. I'm not taking ownership of that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, nobody has taken the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve. It remains unallocated, not signed off or agreed safe by this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, leave it visibly unallocated. Silence isn't someone accepting it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly. And Priya Raman, your GT2 Number 2 Bearing readings are still the drop-everything item, by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yes, I'll have those readings taken by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right. That's where we are, including the gap. Cheers, everyone.
